          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Space is home to many other kinds of animals than those you'd find on Earth. A few animals are hostile and will attack the player, but most are passive. Only a few of them are domesticatable. Animals you find on other worlds can be divided into two categories: hot and cold. Animals can only survive on planets that either have a similar climate to where they came from, or on temperate planets like Earth.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Space animals do not require an oxygenated environment, but it will make the area count as \"temperate\" for their survival. For example, if you bring a cold-dwelling animal (like a Sniffer) to a hot planet (like Venus), it will catch on fire, unless it's inside an oxygenated environment. This makes Earth the ideal place to build a zoo, if you'd like. You can transport animals between planets using AE2's Spatial Storage system.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Moon Animals",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "The Moon may be pretty barren, but it still has a few animals that call it home. It's considered a Cold world despite the pretty extreme temperature swings.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Moon Rabbit",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.name",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Besides their coloring, Moon Rabbits have identical stats to Earth rabbits. They also eat Chorus Fruit.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Limpets are a type of snail with ore on their shell. You can obtain the ore with any mining tool. They are passive and can be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Star Crawler",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.name",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Star Crawlers are a type of starfish. They are hostile and can be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Birts are a type of bird? They lay eggs in their nests, are passive unless attacked, and can be eaten. Their eggs can be thrown to stun targets.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Mars Animals",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.title",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Mars is the planet with an environment closest to Earth's, featuring a wide variety of animals to interact with and crops to feed them (and yourself) with... outside of the huge desert, where almost nothing lives. Mars is a Cold planet.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "The Sandworm",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.title",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Sandworms are alerted by player footsteps. They are the reason almost nothing else lives in the desert.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Sniffers are domesticatable animals found between -30 and -102°C. They require a Large Nest to lay their eggs and can be shorn for Sniffer Tufts. Their eggs can be cooked or extracted for Cream. They eat any Mars crop.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "A sniffer.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Wraptors are domesticatable animals found between -15 and -100°C. They require a Large Nest to lay their eggs and can be shorn for Wraptor Feathers. Their eggs can be cooked or extracted for Wraptor Sugar. They eat any Mars crop.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "A wraptor.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Glacian Sheep",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.title",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Preferring extremely cold environments below -108°C, Glacian Sheep are domesticatable animals. They can be shorn for Glacian Wool, an amazing insulator. They eat any Mars crop.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "A glacian ram/ewe.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Snatchers are passive animals that like to steal your stuff! Attack them to retrieve your items, or feed them Raw Fish to tame them. Once tamed, you can carry them on your back and equip them with a wooden chest. Press to throw them, and they will steal the contents of a nearby chest and bring it to you.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "A snatcher.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.17.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Chargers are semipassive animals. You can tame them with any Mars crop to use them as a combat land mount. Press for a headbutt attack, or press and hold Spacebar for a charge attack. They can also be equipped with dyeable armor.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Chargers have a natural rivalry with Raiders. They will attack each other on sight.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.19.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Surfers are semiaquatic passive animals. You can tame them with Raw Fish to ride them underwater. They can also be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Soarers are passive animals found above -106°C. You can tame them with Raw Fish to use them as a flying mount. They can also be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "A top predator, Eaters are hostile animals found above -109°C. If you can manage to take one down, they can be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Crunchers are territorial miniboss predators. Feed them meat to stop their regeneration. They can also be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Despite their name, Gliders cannot be tamed or ridden. They are passive and live in areas above -105°C. They enjoy music and can be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Crushers are semihostile animals found in herds in areas above -100°C. They can be killed for their meat and hard spikes.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Springlings are wild animals found above -108°C. Feeding them Saplings will let you ride them and extend their extremely long necks. They can also be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Goobers are lazy wild animals found above -109°C. They are passive and can be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.27.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "The gigantic Walkers inhabit areas above -97°C. They are passive and can be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.28.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Raiders are hostile animals found above -109°C. They have a natural rivalry with Chargers. You can make them neutral by feeding them Raw Meat.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.29.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Toxlacanths are aquatic prey animals. It is recommended to kill them from a distance and cook their meat before eating.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.30.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "One of the few animals that can survive the Martian desert, Stackaticks are passive prey animals. They can also be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.31.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "advancement",
          "id": "species:species/v2/ancient_eggs",
          "source": "jar:species-3.5.jar!data/species/advancements/species/v2/ancient_eggs.json",
          "text": "We're Back",
          "key": "advancement-title:title",
          "label": "We're Back",
          "item_ref_count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "advancement",
          "id": "species:species/v2/ancient_eggs",
          "source": "jar:species-3.5.jar!data/species/advancements/species/v2/ancient_eggs.json",
          "text": "Have all Ancient Eggs in your inventory",
          "key": "advancement-description:description",
          "label": "We're Back",
          "item_ref_count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "First, like the Moon, Mars will have some hostile surface mobs as well. If you haven't already figured out how to make your Space Suit stay with you after dying or invested in new EV-tier weaponry, you'll have a rough time.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The planet is mostly a desert world, dotted with \"islands\" where you’ll find water, lush fauna, and much safer places to build your first base. Meanwhile, the open desert is extremely dangerous if you don't watch your step, but contains some other crucial resources!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "All fluid veins are spread across Mars, except for Heavy Ammoniacial Water which can only be found outside of the desert. That’s another good reason to set up your base there.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Energy-wise, Mars will not be kind to you at first.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Nearly every common energy generation method is disabled or worthless on the planet, which means you’ll have to rely almost entirely on Fission to power your base.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "At the very beginning, we recommend bringing along some filled batteries such as Lapotron Crystals to get started, and then look towards setting up Thorium Fuel Rods.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Achieving energy stability on Mars will take time and effort, but once your systems are running smoothly, you’ll feel like unlimited power is right in the palm of your hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "And one last tip: don’t kill everything you see. Some animals can be ranched, and you’ll definitely need them later in your progression.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The water on Mars is Semiheavy which means it contains one Deuterium atom, and is also full of Ammonia, a great antifreeze, which is how it can stay liquid despite the very low temperatures.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "It's technically drinkable, but you'll likely want to distill it into normal Water first. You can also move source blocks of Semiheavy Ammoniacal Water around and get more of it via an Aqueous Accumulator, just like regular Water.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "You can also centrifuge the Ammonium Chloride out from it and electrolyze it as a source of Nitrogen. Easy Nitrox from just one source!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Dotted around the vast Martian deserts are small \"islands\" of life and vegetation, which are probably where you'll want to set up your base. Surviving here will be much easier than in the desert!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",

          "text": "The most simple glass products are Glass Panes and Glass Blocks. In order to craft them, you must start with a Blowpipe with a Glass Batch, and then perform a Pour. - Table Pours are used to create Glass Panes - Basin Pours are used to create Glass Blocks",

          "text": "Glass can also be dyed before it is poured to create colored glass. The color is dependent on the type of glass batch, and any powders that have been added.           "text": "Cryo Freezer",

          "text": "Fuel is hard to get; it requires venturing out to the ocean, looking for oil spouts. The Cryo Freezer introduces a new way to obtain a better fuel - Cryo Fuel. Cryo Fuel is much more efficient than refined fuel, allowing you to launch a rocket with just one bucket.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "It's created by collecting ice shards, which are found as an ore underground on cold planets. The ice shard then needs to be inserted into a Cryo Freezer, and it will convert to 25 mB of Cryo Fuel. Alternatively, you can convert ice, packed ice and blue ice to fuel. Once you've made at least two buckets (one for a launch and the other for a return trip), place the buckets in the rocket fuel slot.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },

          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/surviving_mars/better_fuel.json",
          "text": "Cryo Fuel",

          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 4
        },

          "text": "In addition to being an excellent fuel, cryo fuel has some other features. When placed, it will damage anything inside, similar to lava. It also freezes water, allowing for an infinite ice source.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Better Fuel",

          "text": "The oxygen sensor is a block that will emit a redstone signal when it detects oxygen. You can shift-right-click it to invert the signal. Despite its name, you can also change its detection type by right-clicking with a wrench. It has the option to detect oxygen, safe temperature, and normal gravity.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Detection",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 2
        },

          "text": "The energizer is a machine capable of powering items and storing large amounts of energy.           "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "1. The item you've selected to Create in the Anvil. Each item has a specific set of required Steps and Work Amount 2. The Input item you're currently working. 3. The required Steps in Order that must be completed before the Item is considered complete. There are a total of 4 different Orders (See next Page):",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "(Note: X is a wild-card for any kind of Step) - x_Any: Step can occurr in any of the last 3 actions. - x_Last: Must be the last step performed. - x_Not Last: The Step cannot be the Last Step performed. - x_Second Last: Must be the Second to Last step performed. - x_Third Last: Must be the Third to Last step performed",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "4. The types of Steps. Each type of step Subtracts or Adds to the current Work value. These are, in order from Left to Right, Top to Bottom: - Light Hit: -3 - Medium Hit: -6 - Punch: +2 - Bend: +7 - Hard Hit: -9 - Draw: -15 - Upset: +13 - Shrink: +16",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "5. The Slots where your Hammer goes, and Flux if youre Welding. 6. The current Work amount the item has, Doing different Steps either Increases or Decreases the amount of Work the item has. 7. The Target Work value, the Work value must be aligned EXACTLY with the Target Work, AND the Required Steps must be fulfilled for the Item to be considered complete. 8. The Work Bar, used for Aligning the Work value with the Target Work value.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "How to Perfectly Forge",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Perfectly Forging an Item which can break, such as Tool Heads, Weapons, and Armor causes the Item to gain bonuses to it's durability and general efficiency with the less total steps you take to forge the Item. Completing the Work on an Item with very few steps causes it to be Perfectly Forged, not only giving your finished item bonuses, but also reducing the overall wear and tear to the Hammer.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "A Perfectly Forged Wrought Iron Pickaxe Head",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Guide to Forging",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "This part of the guide will cover how to Perfectly Forge anything, starting with a Wrought Iron Pickaxe Head. DISCLAIMER: While the Required Steps and Orders for an Item are universal within all worlds in TerraFirmaGreg, the Target Work value differs because its derived from your world's Seed, as such, this Guide ASSUMES the Target Work value for the Wrought Iron Pickaxe Head is 83",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 1",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "The first Step in your Forging Journey is to get the Value taken by Adding all of the Required Step's values together. For a Pickaxe Head, you need the following Steps: - Punch Last - Bend Not Last - Draw Not Last. By adding the Values on the Bottom of each Step, We get the Value we're looking for. Lets call this value \"requiredWork\". 2 + 7 + (-15) = -6",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "The steps required for a Pickaxe",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 2",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "While our main goal for the Work Amount is to align it with the Target Work, we need to make sure both that requirement AND the Steps requirements are fulfilled, as such, directly aligning the Work Amount with the Target Work will not yield desirable results. Instead, we can calculate the a value derived from Target Work and \"requiredWork\"",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "This value can be obtained depending on the Sign of \"requiredWork\" (IE: if the value is Negative or Positive). - If \"requiredWork\" is PositiveSubtract \"requiredWork\"'s Absolute Value from \"Target Work\"83 - 6 == 77 - If \"requiredWork\" is NegativeAdd \"requiredWork\"'s Absolute Value to \"Target Work\"83 + 6 = 89",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.17.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Since the \"requiredWork\" for our item is -6, the value we're looking for is 89. You may be wondering, how can you get exact numerical values for your Target Work? Well, the Anvil UI shows us with the Work Bar. It only shows the multiples of 20, but we can know the other numbers easily via the colored lines: - Light Gray: Represents a multiple of 5 - Gray: Represents an Odd Number - Dark Gray: Represents an Even Number",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 3",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "With the value derived from \"Target Work\" and \"requiredWork\", we now need to reach said Work value, this can be done either manually by adding the numbers attached for each step, or by using the cheat sheet in the UI bar. Each color represents the Step Type in the UI. IE: Red == Shrink (+16)",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "16 + 16 + 16 + 16 + 16 + 7 + 2 = 89",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Step 4",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Now that we know the required steps, its time to reach the Value derived from \"Target Work\" and \"requiredWork\". For a pickaxe head where it's TotalWork value is 83, we need to reach 89. As such, we do: (Shrink x 5) -> Bend -> Punch. Once our Work value is at our desired value, just follow the Required Steps, which for a pickaxe head its: Draw -> Bend -> Punch. And Voila! We've obtained a Perfectly Forged Item!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "An Ingot with No Work->Desired Work Value Reached->Doing the Required Steps for our Item.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Lets see this process with other items, such as a Plate, or a Rod. Again, the Target Work differs by the world seed, so their values will be different on your world. Plate Target Value: 111 Required Steps: Hit x 3, Any Order. \"requiredWork\": -3 x 3 = -9 Derived Value: 111 + 9 = 120. Reaching the Value: (Shrink x 5)->(Upset x 2)->(Punch x 2) Getting the Item: 120 - (Light Hit x 3) == 111. Both requirements met.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Rod Target Value: 78 Required Steps: Draw->Draw->Bend \"requiredWork\": (-15 x 2) + 7 = -23 Derived Value: 78 + 23 = 101. Reaching the Value: (Shrink x 5)->(Bend x 3) Getting the Item: 101 - 15 - 15 + 7 = 78.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Other Tidbits",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.title",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "If one of the Required Steps is Empty, it means it's a Wild Card, any Step can be used. If you fail your calculations, you can always melt and cast your item back into an ingot, this will remove the \"worked\" tag for the item, letting you try again to perfectly forge it.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide.json",
          "text": "Congratulations on Reaching the End, if youre a contributor looking to re-take the pictures in this guide, the seed used during it's writing is -7291708953208913102, You could also create a creative world to test the algorithm yourself! Also... since you're here, if you cant be bothered to do all the calculations yourself, you can always use the TFC Anvil Calculator...",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.29.text",
          "label": "Anvil Working Guide",
          "item_ref_count": 17,
          "count": 30
        },
        {

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "The Beneath hosts its own unique selection of wild fruits, which have adapted to the extreme conditions underground. Wild fruits can be cultivated in all the same ways as regular wild fruits in the Overworld.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "- Lavacado - Magmango",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "Temperature: 8 - 80 °C Hydration: 20 - 100 % Lavacado trees grow in the months of December through April, start flowering in May and June, and bear fruit in July.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "An example lavacado tree.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "Temperature: 8 - 80 °C Hydration: 30 - 100 % Magmango trees grow in the months of October through February, start flowering in March and April, and bear fruit in May.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/beneath_wild_fruits.json",
          "text": "An example magmango tree.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Beneath Wild Fruits",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "text": "Rocks!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The easiest way to prevent hazardous effects is to not pick up the dangerous items at all. Filling your inventory with Rocks, for example, will let you pick and choose which items you want to pick up, letting you deal with the hazardous ones later.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Hazardous materials only deal damage while they are in your inventory, but that doesn't apply to other containers! Hazardous materials will not deal damage while they are in another container such as a Backpack or Vessel. Right-clicking while holding a vessel will allow direct transfer of its contents to and from containers.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Face Mask",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Face Mask provides protection from any Inhalation hazards, such as Arsenicosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Rubber gloves",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Rubber gloves can either be made from Leather and Latex, or out of Rubber Sheets. They provide protection from any Skin Contact hazards, such as Beryllium Dust.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "First, knap the leather into mittens.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Mittens are then soaked in Vinegar, a mixture of fruit and alcohol.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Prepared leather gloves are then heated in a vat with Vulcanized Latex, one step away from rubber.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Finally, the latex-soaked gloves are heated in an Oven.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Hazmat Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "A completed Hazmat suit provides immunity from every hazard, even radiation. It is made in an LV Assembler from Polyethylene and Polyvinyl Chloride. Fun fact! You can also look up #ppe_armor in JEI for more equipment that provides protection from hazardous materials.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "In case you do get heavily exposed to a hazard, there are some Medicines that can help you recover. Basic Pills are the most primitive and easy to make, but most come with Negative Side Effects. Tablets and Salvos are more effective and have less side effects, but they require LV equipment and more advanced resources to make.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The RadAwayᵗᵐ pill",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "This is The Ultimate cure for ALL the hazards and the ONLY effective cure to Radiation. However, it is also the most Expensive and Difficult to make, requiring HV tier equipment and advanced materials.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "If all else fails, bringing along a bed to respawn is a good idea. If you don't have access to Wool or String, you can also make a Thatch Bed.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Arsenicosis is an illness caused by inhaling Arsenic from its dust, vapor or Realgar. It slowly increases hunger, followed by nausea, and eventually death. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Arsenicosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Asbestosis is an illness caused by inhaling Asbestos dust. If carried for long enough, it causes hunger. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Asbestosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Berylliosis is an illness caused by skin contact with Beryllium dust or Liquid Beryllium. At first it might seem that it doesn't do much. However, the longer the exposure, the faster it kills you. Gloves and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Berylliosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.17.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carbon Monoxide poisoning",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carbon Monoxide poisoning is an illness caused by inhaling Carbon Monoxide gas. Prolonged exposure causes nausea and quick death. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Carbon Monoxide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carcinogens are substances that cause Cancer. They include Chromium Dust aswell as some organic compounds, such as Benzene and its products. Carcinogens don't go away on their own, but they give plenty of warnings before doing any real harm. It starts off with Weakness, followed by Hunger, then Slowness and later on Mining Fatique. Only when substantial enough exposure is accumulated it causes Death.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.19.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Face Mask protects from inhalation of harmful chemicals, while the Gloves protect from contact with Chromium Dust. The Hazmat Suit protects from both. In case of severe exposure, it is advised to take some Medicines to Prevent any possible damage.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Chemical burns",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Chemical burns are caused by inhalation or skin contact with certain Gases, Acids, Bases or Dusts. Exposure causes Weakness. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from everything.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Irritation is caused by inhalation of Ammonium Formate or skin contact with Chromite Dust. Short contact only causes Weakness, but if ignored for longer it starts Damaging Randomly. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from both.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Methanol poisoning",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Methanol poisoning is caused by inhalation of Methanol. It causes a strong Blindness effect. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit protects from inhalation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Nauseating chemicals",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Nauseating chemicals, such as Butyraldehyde, are substances that cause Nausea when inhaled. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit protect from inhalation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Poisonous materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "There are two types of Poisonous materials. Weak include Lead Dust, while the stronger poisons include Nitrogen Dioxide. Weak poisons cause a Progressively Worsening Poison effect, while Regular poisons cause Weakness and a Stronger Poison effect. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from any contact.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Radioactive materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Most Radioactive substances like Uranium 238 you will only meet at EV tier or above. They will Permanently Irradiate you. Small exposure causes glowing, but prolonged contact triggers a quick Death. We know it looks tasty and has a billion calories, but PLEASE DO NOT EAT URANIUM!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Radioactive materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.27.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Only the Hazmat Suit, as well as some advanced armors provide full protection from radiation. In the case you do get irradiated, only the RadAwayᵗᵐ pill can cure you.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.27.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Silicosis is an illness caused by inhaling Silicon Dioxide Dust. Exposure causes a Reduction in both Health and the Air Supply you have while diving Under Water. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from inhalation of silicon dioxide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.28.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Instead of crafting a wooden pickaxe, you can just pick up rocks from the ground. Begin by collecting at least 4 rocks. You can collect rocks by breaking or right-clicking them with an empty hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "As you begin your journey, the first thing you'll notice is a completely changed world. You can no longer break trees with your fists, but fret not, for any caveman is not a real caveman without his stone tools!",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "{image:tfc:textures/gui/book/gui/rock_knapping.png width:100 height:100 align:center fit:true}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",

          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Iron Age already? Well, I guess it's high time you built yourself a proper ship. The sloop is 4 blocks wide and over 8 blocks long, an impressive upgrade from the rowboat! It holds up to 13 containers and up to 7 passengers, and, depending on the wind, can sail extremely fast. It can also carry up to 6 cannons!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "The sloop is expensive, however, requiring a wealth of wrought iron, copper, wool, and other materials. But materials aren't the only cost! You'll have to learn how to sail, as well, and it can take some practice! You'll also likely want to build docks and other infrastructure if you plan on bringing your ship in close to shore.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/sloop.json",
          "text": "Here is bill of materials for constructing the sloop: 12 Wrought Iron Ingots 24 Copper Ingots 648 Lumber 34 Logs 24 Wool Cloth 6 String 72 Jute Fiber",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 13
        },
        {

          "text": "Much like a rowboat, you'll start with Shipwright's Scaffolding. However, you'll also need a new flat variant for larger ships.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Sloops",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
